grounding.observation: C21 neutral views and reopen pass their narrow gates; actual bend reveals outer-thigh capture. Rejection-c21 preserves that failure.
grounding.comparison: Do not conflate neutral fit with a working deformation field.

expert_coverage.observation: Domain correction preserves low medial body vertices and opposite arm; elbow and garment remain subject to three-view actual inspection.
expert_coverage.comparison: New regression tests do not pass visual form.

film_alignment.observation: Neutral shirt and anatomical donor are only construction prerequisites.
film_alignment.comparison: Full supporting costume, head, crown and horse still need same-film qualification.

preferences.observation: Use the shared correction authority without asking the sleeping Director about an implementation defect.

reference_roles.observation: Neutral donor anchors anatomy; accepted film anchors final fidelity; reference rear remains motion authority.
reference_roles.comparison: No reference role is replaced with a numeric metric.

method.observation: Keep demonstrated neutral construction. Restrict elbow field to anatomical arm domain and exactly retain zero-weight coordinates.
method.comparison: Negative-control thigh points stay identical while forearm moves. Actual full-body render is the decisive check.

interfaces.observation: Original production owners and dependency inventory unchanged. Neutral three views precede bend. Final cast still not edited.
interfaces.comparison: Thigh/shoulder, armhole, cuff and inside elbow must all survive actual render.

efficient_quality.observation: Serial small renders isolate the faulty anatomical domain before leader transfer.
efficient_quality.comparison: Do not spend the pool on finish detail until the actual leader interface works.

authority.observation: Cycle22/max23; six of the additional ten remain unallocated.

strongest_counterexample: The hard arm-domain boundary could cut across donor anatomy or leave inner-elbow collision despite fixing the thigh; actual three-view body and cloth inspection must reject either.
